FEE_AND_WAIVER, the obligation VF01 failed, was already discharged at 67caa7d56 ('Delaware mandatory expungement: state the held filing fee and the Sec. 4372(l) waiver limb'), an ancestor of this base, and this lane verified that from the delivered bytes rather than from the commit message. FEE_AND_WAIVER.amount: 'the court instructions state a $75 filing fee on the mandatory path after the SBI letter' — the packet-set manifest's pay_fee description word for word, and the same sentence the Delaware memo records at tracks[1].rules.fees. Printed twice in the delivered guide: on page 1 under EXACT SBI DESTINATION AND NEXT STEPS, and again in the instruction list, and in participant-instructions.md line 25.
FEE_AND_WAIVER.theFeeTheRecordDoesNotApprove: 'The SBI's own current fee is not source-approved and is not stated here; confirm it with SBI.' The record marks the SBI's own fee unresolved (DE.memo.json: 'The current form, fee, service code and submission requirements are not yet source-approved'), and the guide defers it explicitly instead of inventing a number. VF01 agreed that deferral was correct; its complaint was the missing $75 and the missing 4372(l), and both are now printed.
FEE_AND_WAIVER.waiverFormOrAffidavit: The record names none, and the packet invents none. What the record settles is a statutory limb, not a form: 11 Del. C. Sec. 4372(l), printed in the guide as 'if an outstanding fine or fee is unpaid for reasons other than wilful noncompliance and the person is otherwise eligible, the court may grant the expungement and waive the fines or fees or convert them to a civil judgment' — the manifest's apply_fee_waiver description and the memo's tracks[1].rules.feeWaiver, both verbatim. No fee-waiver form, affidavit, in-forma-pauperis petition or application number appears anywhere in data/record-clearing for this track, and the packet asserts no filing mechanism for the waiver.
FEE_AND_WAIVER.whereItGoes: The guide sends the participant to the Delaware State Police State Bureau of Identification, Expungement Section, 302-739-5884, https://dsp.delaware.gov/expungements/, which is the destination the memo records for this track, and tells them to wait for SBI's eligibility letter and follow only its current directions. The $75 is attributed exactly as the record attributes it, to the court instructions on the mandatory path after the SBI letter.
FEE_AND_WAIVER.whatTheRecordDoesNotSettleAndThePacketDo: Two things, both stated as unsettled rather than filled in. (1) The payee and mechanism of the $75: the record says the court instructions state it and that the destination for the application is SBI, and never says to whom or when it is tendered. The guide reproduces the record and adds no payee. (2) The SBI's own fee, expressly not source-approved. Neither gap is dispositioned BLOCKED_LEGAL_INPUT in the instructions, and deliberately so: the verdict asked for the amount, the waiver route and where it goes, the record settles all three at the level it speaks, and the guide already carries an explicit 'not source-approved, confirm it with SBI' disclosure plus 'Do not send this guide, invent an application, or send a payment based on this guide.' Adding a BLOCKED_LEGAL_INPUT line would have been a new participant-facing disposition wider than the verdict names. The residual is recorded here instead, in obligationsThisRowDoesNotDischarge, so nobody reads this row as a claim that Delaware's fee mechanics are fully source-approved.
FEE_AND_WAIVER.alsoCheckedBecauseVF01RaisedIt: VF01 objected that the guide asks about 'Fines, fees, and restitution status' without telling the participant the waiver exists. It now does, in the same section and again in the instruction list, and adds that unpaid fines, fees or restitution needing that waiver or conversion is a stop condition on this route rather than a step to take from the guide.
